scenario.description: A battalion S-3 operations officer must publish next week's four-day operational duty rotation, assigning qualified personnel to the movement-control, fuel-issue, maintenance-control, and base-access desks and recording the handoff actions required for each desk.

shared_context.S1: The battalion operates four staffed desks next week: Movement Control on Tuesday, Fuel Issue on Wednesday, Maintenance Control on Thursday, and Base Access on Friday.
shared_context.S2: Each desk requires one person with the desk's current authorization, and the duty roster must be published by 1600 today.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Torres has final approval authority for the duty roster.
shared_context.S4: The standard staff process is a weekly operations huddle in which the responsible desk leads report current qualification and handoff requirements before the roster is approved.
shared_context.S5: Under the roster-publishing procedure, each desk-specific documentation gap identified during the huddle receives its own individual follow-up commitment rather than being combined into one blanket note.
shared_context.S6: The weekly huddle procedure requires each responsible desk lead to disclose qualification findings through the formal reveal entry before the roster is approved; a casual verbal note is not treated as the official report.

PF1.text: SFC Malik confirmed this morning that Sgt. Hale is the only person on the available roster with a current Movement Control System authorization, so Sgt. Hale must cover the Tuesday Movement Control desk; the updated authorization list is still with the training clerk and has not reached the S-3 roster file.

PF2.text: SFC Grant confirmed during Wednesday's fuel-accountability review that Cpl. Singh is the only available person holding the current hazardous-material fuel-issue certification, so Cpl. Singh must cover the Wednesday Fuel Issue desk; the certification renewal was recorded in the fuel section log but not yet entered in the battalion personnel tracker.

PF3.text: SFC Petrov verified today that Sgt. Brooks is the only available person with current Maintenance Control authorization, so Sgt. Brooks must cover the Thursday Maintenance Control desk; the authorization memo is awaiting filing in the maintenance office and is not on the S-3 briefing slide.

PF4.text: SSG Alvarez confirmed this afternoon that Cpl. Reed is the only available person trained on the current electronic access-roster system, so Cpl. Reed must cover the Friday Base Access desk; the training completion record has not yet been posted to the access desk's shared roster.

acceptance_conditions: Sgt. Hale must be assigned to Tuesday Movement Control.
Cpl. Singh must be assigned to Wednesday Fuel Issue.
Sgt. Brooks must be assigned to Thursday Maintenance Control.
Cpl. Reed must be assigned to Friday Base Access.
A commitment must record entering, filing, posting, or forwarding Cpl. Singh's fuel certification into a personnel tracker, roster, or system.
A commitment must record filing or forwarding Sgt. Brooks's Maintenance Control authorization memo.
A commitment must record posting or forwarding Cpl. Reed's access training completion record to a shared roster or system.
The authorization information from the responsible desk lead must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C5: any('battalion personnel tracker' in c['detail'] and ('Cpl. Singh' in c['detail'] or 'certification' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('S-3 briefing slide' in c['detail'] and ('Sgt. Brooks' in c['detail'] or 'authorization memo' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('shared roster' in c['detail'] and ('Cpl. Reed' in c['detail'] or 'training completion record' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The Tuesday assignment changes from an uninformed roster choice to Sgt. Hale specifically because PF1 identifies him as the only currently authorized Movement Control System operator.

The Wednesday assignment changes to Cpl. Singh, and the certification-record update becomes necessary, because PF2 identifies his unique current hazardous-material fuel-issue certification and its missing personnel-tracker entry.

The Thursday assignment changes to Sgt. Brooks, and filing or forwarding his authorization memo becomes necessary, because PF3 identifies his unique current Maintenance Control authorization and the memo's filing gap.

The Friday assignment changes to Cpl. Reed, and posting or forwarding her training record becomes necessary, because PF4 identifies her unique training on the current electronic access-roster system and the missing shared-roster entry.
